title: Private Tour with Svetlana
text:
We had an unforgettable experience on our Private Tour of the Barcelona Cathedral, Basilica of Santa Maria del Pi, Basilica of Santa Maria del Mar, and the Gothic Quarter, all thanks to our incredible guide, Svetlana from Roso Travel. From start to finish, Svetlana was warm, knowledgeable, and deeply passionate about the rich history and beauty of Barcelona.

She brought each site to life with fascinating stories, historical insights, and fun facts that kept us fully engaged. Her pacing was perfect, allowing us time to explore, take photos, and truly appreciate each location. Svetlana's expert
author: Claudette_W

title: Barcelona Cathedral
text:
On the days we are in Barcelona we celebrate the patron saint of the city. Therefore in the Cathedral we witnessed a wonderful Holy Mass. 
I don t know how much it costs to enter because in the various churches I have always entered to pray (it seems to me 12 euros each if I m not mistaken)
In front of the Church in the very large square with on one side many stalls with various local products (perhaps for the occasion of the patron)
author: Q5150GNantonellag

title: Santa Maria del Mar
text:
The Church and its square are wonderful! The interior equally beautiful! 
Entrance is free. We attended the Holy Mass, very impressive! 
It stayed in my heart
author: Q5150GNantonellag

title: Great exploration of the Gothic area
text:
We had a fabulous time! Our flight ran a little late and I notified our tour guide and he patiently waited for us. Carlos was great -
showed us all around the Gothic area and gave us all the history details. Thank you!
author: Kathleen_P
